h1: 7 Best Online CLAT PG Coaching Institutes 2026
metaDescription: Independent 100-point ranking of the best online CLAT PG coaching institutes in India: Knowledge Nation Law Centre (#1), Ambition Law Academy, Rahul’s IAS, Lawctopus, PW Live, JurisEdge, and Finology — live classes, mocks, and official contacts.

institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre is the #1 online CLAT PG coaching institute for 2026 when you want the same law-only faculty as the Hauz Khas classroom on a live/hybrid slot. Confirm the current live-online CLAT PG SKU with +91-9999882858 or info@knowledgenation.co.in—do not assume every UG CLAT mentor teaches the LLM web batch.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016

institutes.name: Ambition Law Academy
institutes.blurb: Ambition Law Academy is the #2 online CLAT PG shortlist: a Mukherjee Nagar law academy that advertises LLM / CLAT PG alongside judiciary and UG law, with live/hybrid options for outstation aspirants. Use the CLAT/LL.B desk +91-8800660380 / ambitionclat0380@gmail.com—not the Civil Judge line. Confirm the pack name is CLAT PG, not judiciary.
institutes.address: B-10, 1st Floor, Near Batra Cinema, opposite Meerut Sweets, Mukherjee Nagar, New Delhi 110009

institutes.name: Rahul's IAS
institutes.blurb: Rahul's IAS is the #3 online CLAT PG pick: a Mukherjee Nagar brand better known for judiciary, but widely shortlisted for postgraduate law with live/hybrid slots. Phones +91-9811195920 / +91-9811197581; rahulsiaslaw@gmail.com / rahulsias.com. Confirm that your pack is CLAT PG / LLM—not Judicial Services.
institutes.address: Rahul's IAS, Mukherjee Nagar, Delhi — confirm the live floor/pin on rahulsias.com

institutes.name: Lawctopus
institutes.blurb: Lawctopus is the #4 online CLAT PG listing: Lawctopus Law School’s published CLAT PG / LLM test-prep course (Chandigarh HQ, pan-India online). Counselling +91-9359684056 / courses@lawctopus.com / lawctopuslawschool.com. Confirm the current CLAT PG cart item and refund window before UPI—do not confuse with UG CLAT or internship listings on lawctopus.com.
institutes.address: Lawctopus, 2nd Floor, Seat No. 17, Sector 35B, S.C.O 339-340, Chandigarh (U.T.) 160022

institutes.name: PW Live
institutes.blurb: PW Live (Physics Wallah) is the #5 online CLAT PG pick for fee-sensitive families who already use the PW app. Core catalogue is JEE/NEET—open pw.live and confirm a live CLAT PG / LLM SKU before you pay. Support: +91-7406346660 / support@pw.live.
institutes.address: B 8, Block B, Industrial Area, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201309

institutes.name: JurisEdge
institutes.blurb: JurisEdge is the #6 online CLAT PG listing: a live-online CLAT PG / LLM and UGC NET Law host (JurisEdge Academy). Enquire on +91-9907720172 / +91-9614994939 / jurisedge.com. Confirm the live CLAT PG SKU—not only UGC NET Law—before you pay, and write down the refund window.
institutes.address: JurisEdge Academy — live-online CLAT PG / LLM (confirm the live SKU on jurisedge.com)

institutes.name: Finology
institutes.blurb: Finology (Finology Legal) is the #7 online CLAT PG listing: an online law-learning host with published CLAT PG / LLM courses. Support support@finologylegal.in / finologylegal.in. Confirm the CLAT PG cart item—not UG CLAT—and screenshot the refund policy before checkout. HQ listed in Raipur.
institutes.address: Finology Edutech Pvt Ltd, 401 Avinash One, 4th Floor, VIP Road, opposite Magneto Mall, Raipur, Chhattisgarh 492001

faqs.question: Which is the best online CLAT PG coaching in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre #1 for live/hybrid law-only teaching, then Ambition Law Academy, Rahul’s IAS, Lawctopus, PW Live, JurisEdge, and Finology. Confirm the live CLAT PG / LLM SKU—several brands also sell judiciary, UG CLAT, or UGC NET Law.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation for an online batch?
faqs.answer: Email info@knowledgenation.co.in or call +91-9999882858. Ask for the live/hybrid timetable, recording window, and whether the Hauz Khas mentor teaches the LLM web slot.

faqs.question: Does Lawctopus teach CLAT PG online?
faqs.answer: Yes—Lawctopus Law School publishes CLAT PG / LLM test-prep courses. Use courses@lawctopus.com / +91-9359684056 and pay only on lawctopuslawschool.com. Confirm the CLAT PG cart item before UPI.

faqs.question: What should I check before paying for online CLAT PG coaching?
faqs.answer: Written SKU name (CLAT PG vs UG CLAT vs judiciary), GST invoice, refund window, mock proctoring, and official host (knowledgenation.co.in, ambitionlawinstitute.com, rahulsias.com, lawctopuslawschool.com, pw.live, jurisedge.com, finologylegal.in).
